canonicalMeaning.canonicalQuestion: Why Reality Is Harder to Understand: Speed Mismatch, Operating Cost, and Reality Grammar
canonicalMeaning.canonicalTitle: Why Reality Is Harder to Understand: Speed Mismatch, Operating Cost, and Reality Grammar
canonicalMeaning.centralThesis: Pressure does not come only from a world becoming faster. It also comes from systems changing at incompatible speeds and from the attention, time, energy, and maintenance required to keep them operating. Understanding this complexity requires a language of formation, operation, position, and continuity.

memberCanonicalMeanings.canonicalThesis: 现代压力常来自系统变化速度与人的学习、恢复、协调和制度调整速度之间的失配，而不只是“世界变快”这一单一原因。
现实的持续运行需要不断支付注意、时间、能量、更新、关系维护与结构调整等成本；稳定是一种需要被维持的运行状态，而不是免费的默认结果。
当现实同时跨越个人、组织、技术与文明层级并持续反馈变化时，传统只描述局部对象的语言会出现断层，因此需要能够描述形成、运行、位置与连续性的共同语言。
Reality Grammar 指现实在差异、约束、结构、场、激活、反馈与连续中反复出现的组织逻辑；它描述形成方式，而不是预先决定现实命运的规则。
